content.LessFille (kadang ditulis LessFille atau: LessFille (sometimes written LessFille or Lessfile/Lesfile) is a boneless fried chicken specialist in Solo & surrounding areas. Established before 2025, it grew rapidly by offering generous boneless chicken portions, signature seasoning, and student-friendly value packages. Popular among Gen-Z & millennials as a group dining and take-away spot.
content.Saus premium (pilihan: creamy, pedas, ma: Premium sauce (options: creamy, spicy, sweet, savory, signature)
content.Untuk yang ingin murah tapi tetap kenyan: Budget-friendly yet filling, ideal for students
content.Nasi (ambil sendiri sepuasnya, sekali am: Self-serve rice (all you can scoop, single serving)
content.Semua rasa & varian saus premium tersedi: All flavors & premium sauce variants available
content.(Signature lainnya, info detail di Insta: (Other signature sauces — see Instagram or in-store for details)
content.Ayam disajikan panas, renyah luar, juicy: Served hot, crispy outside and juicy inside, generous boneless cuts with real meat rather than just batter.
content.Saus kental, terasa bumbu, bukan rasa “s: Rich, thick sauces packed with seasoning, never tasting like cheap sauce.
content.Sistem pemesanan mudah: pilih paket, pil: Simple ordering system: pick a package, pick a flavor, relax at your seat, and refill your drink yourself.
content.Kadang LessFille membuat promo besar (gr: LessFille occasionally runs major promos (grand openings, special days) such as 100 free portions for the first visitors — check Instagram & TikTok for updates.
content.Semua menu halal, tanpa MSG, cocok buat: All menu items are halal, MSG-free, and include vegetable options suitable for vegetarians (ask at the counter).
content.Tidak pakai hardware-ordering, pesan lan: No kiosk hardware ordering — order directly at the cashier or table, payable via cash & e-money.
content.LessFille = ayam boneless kekinian, pors: LessFille = modern boneless fried chicken, generous portions, student- and couple-friendly prices, 3 main branches across Solo Raya, drink & rice refill system, premium sauces, frequent promos, and active social media updates for the latest menus and variants.
content.Upgrade ke Paket (+4K): 1 Burger, Es Teh: Upgrade to Combo (+4K): 1 Burger, Iced Tea, and Corn Twist.
content.Sudah termasuk Nasi, Ayam Boneless, Baya: Includes Steamed Rice, Boneless Chicken, Crispy Fried Spinach, Scrambled Egg, and Iced Tea. Regular packages come with a larger chicken portion, 1x unlimited initial rice scoop, and unlimited free iced tea refills.
